messages:
alex kim: Handoff to @maria — a few things to watch during my shift and into tomorrow morning. TL;DR: latency blips on model-gptq-28 after the recent quant rollout, a scheduled DB migration at 02:00 UTC, and an autoscaler tweak rolled out earlier today.

alex kim: Notes:
- Latency: p95 token latency for model-gptq-28 jumped from ~85ms -> ~320ms for 512-token requests between 22:10-22:25 UTC; it recovered after a rolling pod restart but we saw two brief fallback events to model-small. If p95 > 250ms for >5min, rollback to model-gptq-28-stable (runbook below).
- Autoscaling: hpa minReplicas bumped to 3 in us-west-2 this morning to help burst traffic; watch queue length and minus-one scale errors.
- DB migration: scheduled schema apply at 02:00 UTC (non-blocking) — migration job will create indexes on inference_logs; there is a short increase in DB CPU expected (~5-7m).
- Cache: prefix cache eviction rate increased slightly after the quant rollout; watch cache_hit_ratio and prefix_cache_evictions.

alex kim: Quick commands to check status:
```
# latency quick check
curl -sS https://metrics.internal/api/series?m=p95_token_latency&model=model-gptq-28 | jq .
# oncluster checks
kubectl -n inference get hpa,deploy -l app=inference
# runbook (internal)
https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-gptq-quantization
```

maria gonzalez: Thanks — I'll take it. Will monitor the p95 panel and set a dashboard alert for immediate paging at 250ms. Can you paste the exact rollback command?

alex kim: Rollback command in runbook but quick one-liner if needed:
```
redwoodctl deploy rollback --model model-gptq-28 --to model-gptq-28-stable --reason "p95 regression"
```

alex kim: Also FYI I'm swapping tomorrow 09:00-13:00 UTC with @tony wu — Tony will cover the morning window. @tony please ack if that still works for you.

ton y wu: Acked, I can cover 09:00-13:00 UTC. Will keep an eye on the DB migration start.

sara patel: Small FYI — I pushed a small logging change to inference-proxy that increases log level on 500s for a bit, should help debugging if the cache evictions correlate to 500s. Pushing to canary now.

oncall-bot: Deploy notice: inference-proxy canary started at 23:05 UTC (deploy id: dp-4991). Health checks passing (3/3).

maria gonzalez: I'll set an ephemeral alert: if prefix_cache_evictions > 50/min AND 500_errors > 10/min, escalate to pages. Leaving note to check canary logs.

ton y wu: If the rollback happens, who should own the model regression postmortem? I can create the initial doc if needed.

alex kim: Preferably research + infra co-own; @sara can you start a stub postmortem if we need one? I'll add links and signal path.

sara patel: Yep — I'll create a stub in /docs/postmortems and tag infra/research.

maria gonzalez: Taking it — I'll monitor the alerts and post updates here if anything changes. Leaving this in good shape: autoscaler min=3, rollback cmd noted, DB migration at 02:00 UTC, canary running.

alex kim: Thanks all. If nothing else, I expect a quiet night but will be available by DM until 00:30 UTC.

maria gonzalez: Got it, thanks.
